_note: The season report card. Marks are chosen by app/engine/report.py; {braces} are filled with the season's numbers (coin in ◈, shares in %).

marks.pace.A: You're worth {worth}◈, {share}% of next season's Passage ({passage}◈). That's ahead of where you need to be.
marks.pace.B: You're worth {worth}◈, {share}% of next season's Passage. Close, but you want about {target}% by now.
marks.pace.C: You're worth {worth}◈, {share}% of next season's Passage. You want about {target}% by now, and wages alone won't close that gap.
marks.pace.D: You're worth {worth}◈, only {share}% of next season's Passage ({passage}◈). At this rate the ship leaves without you.
marks.tides.A: Every tide went to something: {work} shifts of work, the rest on trades.
marks.tides.B: One tide went unused. That's about {cost}◈ in wages you didn't earn.
marks.tides.C: {idle} tides went unused, about {cost}◈ you could have earned.
marks.tides.D: {idle} of your {total} tides went unused. That's about {cost}◈ in wages left on the table.
marks.food.hungry: Your household went hungry. You start next season 2 tides short.
marks.food.card: Kelp went on your Leviathan card, and that balance grows every season you carry it.
marks.food.dark_short: Your cellar holds {stored} kelp going into the Long Dark, when kelp costs about {dark_price}◈ each. Your household eats {need}.
marks.food.stocked: You stocked the cellar ahead of time, so the household didn't pay the season-end price.
marks.food.bought: Your household bought {bought_at_end} kelp at the season-end price, {cost_at_end}◈ in all. Kelp bought earlier, when it's cheap, costs less.
marks.safety.scam: You lost {lost}◈ to the Pearl Exchange. Nobody can promise 40% a season.
marks.safety.lost: You lost {lost}◈ to thieves and charges you didn't dispute.
marks.safety.no_vault: All {purse}◈ sits in your Purse. You have no Vault yet; Ione can open one at the Bank for free.
marks.safety.vault_locked: All {purse}◈ sits in your Purse. The Bank won't give you a Vault until your Standing reaches {standing}.
marks.safety.idle: {purse}◈ sat in your Purse at season's end. It earns nothing there, and a full Purse draws pickpockets.
marks.safety.kept: Most of your coin is in the Vault, where it earned {interest}◈ and can't be stolen.
marks.safety.fair: {purse}◈ in your Purse, {vault}◈ in the Vault. Fine, though Purse coin earns nothing.
marks.debt.reef: You owe Grin. His fee adds half again every season, and nobody boards owing him.
marks.debt.missed: A payment was missed. That cost a late fee, and the Bank trusts you less for it.
marks.debt.card: Your card balance cost {card_interest}◈ in interest this season.
marks.debt.loan: Your loans cost {interest}◈ in interest this season.
marks.debt.interest_free: You owe {debt}◈, but none of it charged interest this season. It still has to be paid before you board.
marks.debt.none: You owe nothing. Every coin you earn is yours.

chelo._note: Chelo's note when the AI isn't available: one 'praise' line for the best A mark (if any), then one 'ask' line for the worst C or D mark (by mark, else by subject), else 'steady'.

praise.pace.A: You're ahead of the price of Passage, and very few in this city can say that.
praise.debt.none: You owe nobody a single coin, which makes you freer than most.
praise.debt.interest_free: What you owe costs you nothing for now, a rare kindness in Atlantis.
praise.food.stocked: Your cellar was full before anyone else thought to look.
praise.safety.kept: Your coin sat in the Vault, where no pickpocket could reach it.
praise.tides.A: Not one tide wasted. The sea notices that sort of thing.

ask.pace: Passage will cost {passage}◈ next season. Where is the rest of it coming from?
ask.tides: {idle} tides went by with nothing to show for them. What would one more shift each season add up to?
ask.food.hungry: A hungry house loses tides, and tides are coin. What would a full cellar have cost you back in Summer?
ask.food.card: That kelp will cost more every season it sits on your card. Was it cheaper to buy it earlier?
ask.food.dark_short: Kelp costs about {dark_price}◈ in the Long Dark. How full will your cellar be when it comes?
ask.safety.scam: Somebody promised you 40% a season. Who do you think was really getting paid?
ask.safety: If a pickpocket found your Purse tomorrow, how much would they walk away with?
ask.debt.reef: Grin's fee grows by half every season. How many seasons can you afford to owe him?
ask.debt.missed: One missed payment costs more than its fee. How will the Bank remember this season?
ask.debt: What will that debt have cost you by the time the last ship calls?

chelo.steady: A steady season. If the next one goes wrong, which of your choices still holds up?
